steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Select the mount for the P300‑Multi and P20‑Multi pipettes, specify the number of destination plates (maximum 7), upload the Transfer CSV (header row with columns: Source Well, Destination Plate, Destination Well, Sample Volume, Diluent Volume), and enter the notification email address and its password if email alerts are desired.

substeps.instruction: Choose P300‑Multi mount (left or right).
Choose P20‑Multi mount (left or right).
Enter number of destination plates (1‑7).
Upload CSV containing Source Well, Destination Plate, Destination Well, Sample Volume, Diluent Volume.
Provide email address for notifications (optional).
Provide password for the notification email (optional).

steps.title: Distribute diluent with P300 (>20 µL)
steps.instruction: Using the P300 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), pick up a tip column, dispense diluent to every well that requires a volume greater than 20 µL across all destination plates, then discard the tip column in the trash.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a tip column with the P300 pipette.
Aspirate diluent and dispense to each well needing >20 µL.
Repeat until all such wells on up to seven plates are filled.
Drop the used tip column into the trash.

steps.title: Distribute diluent with P20 (≤20 µL)
steps.instruction: Using the P20 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), pick up a tip column, dispense diluent to every well that requires a volume of 20 µL or less, then discard the tip column in the trash.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a tip column with the P20 pipette.
Aspirate diluent and dispense to each well needing ≤20 µL.
Repeat until all such wells on up to seven plates are filled.
Drop the used tip column into the trash.

steps.title: Add protein plate to deck
steps.instruction: The robot pauses, prompts the user to place the protein source plate in slot 8, and (if email notifications are enabled) sends an email alert at this point.

substeps.instruction: Protocol pauses and displays a prompt.
User places the protein plate in deck slot 8.
If email notifications are enabled, send an email to the specified address.

steps.title: Transfer samples >20 µL with mixing
steps.instruction: For each well/column where the Sample Volume exceeds 20 µL, the P300 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2) picks up a fresh tip, transfers the sample, mixes the destination well four times, and then discards the tip.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip with the P300 pipette for each transfer.
Aspirate the specified sample volume (>20 µL) from the source well.
Dispense into the destination well.
Mix the destination well by aspirating/dispensing 4 times.
Drop the used tip into the trash.

steps.title: Transfer samples ≤20 µL with mixing
steps.instruction: For each well/column where the Sample Volume is 20 µL or less, the P20 8‑Channel Pipette (GEN2) picks up a fresh tip, transfers the sample, mixes the destination well four times, and then discards the tip.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip with the P20 pipette for each transfer.
Aspirate the specified sample volume (≤20 µL) from the source well.
Dispense into the destination well.
Mix the destination well by aspirating/dispensing 4 times.
Drop the used tip into the trash.

steps.title: Notify completion and remove samples
steps.instruction: When all transfers are finished, the protocol ends and, if email notifications are enabled, an email is sent to inform the user that the samples can be removed for downstream applications.

substeps.instruction: Protocol signals completion.
If email notifications are enabled, send a final email alert.
